name: Second Wind (Combat)
body:
You are able to take a momentary breather and then get back in the battle.

Benefit(s): If your current hp total is less than your maximum normal hp, but is equal to or greater than your Constitution score, you may expend a full-round action to regain a number of hp equal to your level. You may use this ability a number of times per day equal to your Constitution bonus.

Blood & Steel, Book 1: The Fighter. Copyright 2014, d20pfsrd.com Publishing; Author: Taylor Hubler.
